Cy H. Myers wrote:
>
> Hi all,
> I'm really rusty on my rules, so I've got a simple question: can you
> play Legacy of Power if you are entering a combat as a result of being blocked?
> I don't remember the rules surrounding who can play reactions.
>
Only minions controlled by a methuselah who does *not* control the
acting vampire may play reactinos. So, to answer your question... no.
If you control the acting vampire, none of your vampires may play Legacy
of Power (or any other reaction).

-Chris
